notes.title: Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hello hoomans! ːcathspawː

We know you've been eagerly awaiting the release of A Tower Full of Cats, and we come bearing some exciting updates!

First and foremost, we want to thank you immensely for your support and patience. Over the past few months, we've been working tirelessly to deliver a game that is truly special to us.

However, as sometimes happens, we've had to deal with some unexpected detours. Unfortunately, cats are easily distracted, and since we are handling many projects (some yet unannounced ːwinkycatː), a delay was inevitable!

Additionally, we decided to redo some of the scenarios to ensure that the experience of A Tower Full of Cats is the best possible. ːfofinoː

https://i.imgur.com/3um8XKr.png
Prehistory before and after

But now we finally have a release date! A Tower Full of Cats will be released on May 20th. We're working hard to ensure that every aspect of the game is perfect, and we want to make the wait worth it! ːfofino2ː

We are immensely grateful for your continued support on this journey. We're very excited to share A Tower Full of Cats with you soon! 

Love and Purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ
